label: PF Backlog 652
title: Execution trail: OpenCode Go token pricing/cost + box-drawn (Cursor-style) tables

brief.problem: Trail usage shows cost 0 because no OpenCode Go pricing is wired and tables are raw markdown.
brief.what_adds: A pricing config + cost calculation and Cursor-style box tables in the trail show.
brief.why_now: HIL needs real cost and a readable completion table per item.
brief.success: Cost reflects OpenCode Go list prices; the trail renders as proper tables.

objective: Compute review/session cost from OpenCode Go list prices and render the execution-trail stages/tests/final completion as box-drawn tables.
acceptance_criteria: config/model-pricing.json (registered; source=opencode.ai/data, unit=USD per 1M tokens) maps the review/session models (mimo-v2.6-flash: input 0.14/output 0.28/cached 0.0028; deepseek-v4.1-flash: 0.07/0.30/0.0015; deepseek-v4-flash: 0.30/1.20/0.0060) and the trail computes cost = (input-cached)*input + cached*cached_input + output*output per 1M, preferring provider-reported cost when present.

python -m core.execution_trail show --item <ID> renders the stage, test and final completion tables as box-drawn (Cursor-style) tables with wrapped cells; usage shows input/output/cached/cost and 'not captured' when a source is absent.

Tests cover the cost formula, unknown-model cost_source=unavailable, provider-reported cost precedence, box table rendering/wrapping, and the existing trail/check behavior; precheck (including the execution-trail completion gate) passes.
out_of_scope: Changing the gate order or pricing for models not in the catalog.
approach: Add config/model-pricing.json (opencode.ai/data list prices, USD/1M) and registry entry; add price_usage()/box table rendering to core/execution_trail.py; record provider cost when supplied else compute (input-cached)*input + cached*cached_input + output*output; show wraps cells in Unicode box tables; completion can attach item.execution.usage if a worker recorded it. Add tests for cost/unknown/provider-cost/box wrapping.

prior_decisions: OpenCode Data list prices (opencode.ai/data) are the pricing authority
assumptions: Cost uses (input-cached)*input + cached*cached_input + output*output per 1M; provider cost wins when present.
Review usage captures model+input+output+cached; session usage is recorded only if the harness/worker writes item.execution.usage.
Tables are rendered with Unicode box drawing and wrapped cells; no external table dependency.
divergences: A new pricing config store is added (registered) instead of hardcoding prices in code.

evidence: config/model-pricing.json (registered; source=opencode.ai/data, unit=USD per 1M tokens) maps the review/session models (mimo-v2.6-flash: input 0.14/output 0.28/cached 0.0028; deepseek-v4.1-flash: 0.07/0.30/0.0015; deepseek-v4-flash: 0.30/1.20/0.0060) and the trail computes cost = (input-cached)*input + cached*cached_input + output*output per 1M, preferring provider-reported cost when present.

python -m core.execution_trail show --item <ID> renders the stage, test and final completion tables as box-drawn (Cursor-style) tables with wrapped cells; usage shows input/output/cached/cost and 'not captured' when a source is absent.

Tests cover the cost formula, unknown-model cost_source=unavailable, provider-reported cost precedence, box table rendering/wrapping, and the existing trail/check behavior; precheck (including the execution-trail completion gate) passes.

impact_review.evidence: Edits to the existing allowlisted control-plane tooling module; pricing is config.
Extends execution_trail show/usage; no new engine.
Provider cost wins; unknown models -> cost_source=unavailable; no fabrication.
Show output + usage fields; rollback is a revert; trail data remains.

verification: Objective achieved: Execution trail: OpenCode Go token pricing/cost + box-drawn (Cursor-style) tables
risks: Pricing changes upstream: config is versioned with source URLs; unknown models are marked unavailable.
rollback: Revert the config/code commit; trail data remains.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Add OpenCode model pricing entries to the Go cost/pricing module (new Go source next to existing cost owner); reuse core/cost_model.py + /api/v1/runs/time-cost for rollup; render Cursor-style box-drawn tables via a shared Go table formatter used by CLI/report output.
